class.name: SteamLobby
class.brief_description: Social operations and observations for one exact Steam lobby membership.

method.name: listing
method.description: Return a detached listing using current presentation and counts while active. After closing, return the initial snapshot.

method.name: members
method.description: Copy up to 65 current Steam lobby members. An unavailable membership returns an empty array.

method.name: edit
method.description: Return an empty edit for this membership. Call [method SteamLobbyEdit.submit] to check live ownership and write.

method.name: tag
method.description: Read the bounded value of one nonreserved application key. Return an empty string when unavailable or absent.

method.name: set_joinable
method.description: Set whether Steam can accept new members into this standalone lobby. The current Steam owner can call this. Game-owned lobbies and guests return [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED].

method.name: leave
method.description: Leave this standalone membership, releasing its account reservation before [signal closed]. A Game-owned membership returns [constant ERR_UNAUTHORIZED].

method.name: invite
method.description: Submit one Steam lobby invitation from its current owner to a selected decimal individual SteamID64. A malformed ID or the local account returns [constant ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER]. [constant OK] acknowledges submission.

method.name: open_invite_dialog
method.description: Request the Steam invite picker for the current owner's lobby. Return [constant ERR_BUSY] while the overlay is still unavailable and [constant OK] when submitted.

method.name: send_chat
method.description: Submit nonempty UTF-8 text of up to 1024 bytes with no ASCII controls, at most once per 250 milliseconds. [constant OK] acknowledges submission. Use [signal chat_received] to observe delivery.

signal.name: members_changed
signal.description: Emitted with a current bounded snapshot after a Steam member event for this lobby.

signal.name: chat_received
signal.description: Emitted for bounded text from a current Steam lobby member, including the local sender. A scope observes at most 20 messages per second.

signal.name: closed
signal.description: Emitted once after this view stops serving live actions. Explicit leave uses [constant OK], scope teardown uses [constant ERR_SKIP], and Steam-reported loss uses [constant ERR_CONNECTION_ERROR].
